A record of DeepSNO hypotheses, evaluation results, and decisions. Each report
links its conclusions to a code version, resolved configuration, and dataset.
Training metrics and checkpoints remain in their existing run storage.

Start with the [workflow](workflow.qmd). Reports marked **in progress** or
**method audit** do not establish a performance improvement.
